name: Big Three
summary: Chinese climbing shedding game where threes are highest and one bidder with 20 cards plays alone against two allied opponents.
rules_text: Three players, 52 cards ranking 3 high, then 2, A, K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4 low. Deal 16 cards each counter-clockwise taken from a central deck, 4 cards left face down as kitty. Auction: player with 4 of Hearts or lowest heart if 4H is in kitty must bid at least 1. Bids are 1, 2, 3, higher only. Two passes or a bid of 3 ends auction. Winner takes the 4 kitty cards. Whoever held lowest heart leads first. Legal plays: single, pair, triplet, quad, run of 3+ singles, run of 3+ pairs, run of 3+ triplets, run of 3+ quads. Aces, twos, threes cannot be in runs. After a lead, each player in order must pass or beat previous play with same type and same number of cards but higher rank. If two consecutive players pass, the pile is cleared and the player who played the highest combo leads any type. First to empty hand wins the hand. If bidder wins, each opponent pays bid; if bidder loses, bidder pays each opponent bid.
